scope: Selected collectors, instrumented adapters and offline parsers; not whole-backend certification or native validation.

runtimes.route_kind: actual source route: unified bpftrace runtime hooks plus stackagg registry
runtimes.identity: Collector runtime.execute assigns @current_g[tid]=AX; profile event reads that same mapping. newproc1 returns child raw*g. stackagg increments generation per observed create, raw_g#N; missing-create observations use a separate observed-instance path. Raw*g is not numeric Go goid or resource identity.
limits: Source inspection only; no BPF attach/runtime/architecture compatibility validation. Register AX/BX/CX conventions depend on pinned Go ABI/architecture, not portable guarantees.

Resume/ready/suspend emissions are gap-throttled; omitted transitions prevent treating every observed pair as complete runnable/IO wait intervals. Sampling CPU stacks does not identify lock/channel/socket owner or request causality automatically.
Generation increments require delivered create events; missed events and midstream attachment require explicit coverage qualification. Coroutine exit does not establish heap/resource final release.
Language README describes this route, not fresh native validation or current performance/overhead.

source_anchors.fact: Documents raw*g generations, runtime hooks and in-sample thread binding.
newproc1 entry saves parent BX/caller CX; return emits child retval plus creation stack.
execute sets current_g; park/exit clear it; profile:hz condition reads it when sampling.
Registry create branch increments generation and assigns raw_g#N; exit branch records exited and removes active mapping.

runtimes.route_kind: Configured ELF-offset eBPF lifecycle collector plus generation-aware frame graph adapter
runtimes.identity: Collector emits TaskPtr as frame; inspected adapter distinguishes address generations and tracks actual instance. Correct upstream ABI/register extraction remains unverified in this focused scope.
runtimes.creator_association: Conditional: adapter consumes explicit parent_frame, parent_status and parent_source; links only an observed live non-self parent generation. This does not establish that every collector execution supplies those fields.
limits: Requires target executable/PID, compiled BPF object, valid create/resume/return/destroy sites and usable BPF/uprobe permissions; none tested here.
Periodic sample capture is optional; sample-frequency defaults to zero. Event availability does not prove loss-free capture or CPU attribution.
C++20 frame route does not certify stackful ST, Helio fibers or Boost.Asio spawn/yield_context; separate identity/lifecycle evidence is required.
libuv callbacks, handles and OS workers must not be relabeled C++20 coroutine frames without an explicit demonstrated bridge.
Frame creation ancestry does not establish ownership of mutexes, queues, requests or resources; each case needs explicit observer evidence.

source_anchors.fact: CLI collector entrypoint; requires executable, target PID and configured probe sites.
Event tags: create snapshot, resume, resume return, destroy, sample snapshot.
Raw event carries TaskPtr alongside PID/TID, timestamp, kind, CPU and stack ID; register-to-frame correctness not verified here.
Decoded event counters include zero-frame creates, resume entries/returns, destroy and sample snapshots.
Lifecycle text emitter labels nonzero TaskPtr as frame.
Collector rejects incomplete configured site sets when running bindings are enabled.
Adapter creates per-address generations; raw frame address alone is not lifetime identity.
Creator binding consumes parent_frame/status/source; rejects self-parent, unavailable parent generation or non-live parent; emits edge only after these checks.

runtimes.route_zh: 指定 ELF 偏移的 eBPF 生命周期采集器及图适配器
runtimes.identity_zh: 协程 frame 地址；图适配器处理地址代次，creator 需要明确的父 frame 证据。
runtimes.limits_zh: 采样默认关闭；ABI、寄存器、探针点及权限尚未验证。不能据此推定 stackful fiber／回调覆盖。

runtimes.route_kind: Configured Tokio runtime ELF-offset eBPF lifecycle collector
runtimes.identity: Source retains runtime TaskPtr in emitted task_ptr. It does not establish a separate identity for every nested Future; arbitrary Future poll/await is not necessarily another runtime Task or a scheduler yield.
runtimes.creator_association: Unknown in this focused audit: inspected raw lifecycle record/text emitter does not itself provide parent Task identity. A creation stack is not a verified creator-Task link. Tokio graph reconstruction was not inspected in this recovery scope.
limits: Requires compatible target runtime probe offsets, executable/PID, compiled BPF object and permitted BPF/uprobe attachment; not validated.
Poll and complete offsets are mandatory; observing complete is distinct from observing deallocation. Missing optional create/dealloc sites limits lifetime closure.
Raw Task pointer reuse/generation reconstruction and creator graph correctness were not audited here.
This runtime route does not certify async-std/futures-rs/hyper or every Rust executor; nested Future, runtime Task and OS worker differ.
No standalone periodic CPU-sample event is established by this collector event mapping; CPU integration and runnable/queue delay require additional evidence.
Task lifecycle and creation stacks do not establish wait queue membership or resource ownership without per-case observation.

source_anchors.fact: CLI collector entrypoint loads BPF object and attaches executable-offset uprobes for specified PID.
Event tags cover poll enter/return, complete, shutdown, dealloc, create and create snapshot.
Raw event carries TaskPtr, PID/TID, timestamp, kind, CPU and stack ID; this inspected record has no parent Task field.
Collector requires configured poll and complete offsets; creation/deallocation coverage depends on additional configured probes.
Text emitter retains nonzero TaskPtr; task creation can include stack ID.
Maps event kinds to rt_raw_poll, poll-return, harness-complete, shutdown, dealloc and Cell::new-return names.

runtimes.route_zh: 指定 ELF 偏移的 eBPF Task 生命周期采集器
runtimes.identity_zh: 实际 Task 指针，不等于每个嵌套 Future；本次未检查下游分代／creator 关联。
runtimes.limits_zh: 必需 poll／complete 探针，create／dealloc 可选；未确立独立 CPU 采样事件，也不代表所有 Rust executor。

runtimes.route_kind: actual source route: instrumented Task factory/get_stack/done callback; separate thread-only CPython USDT converter
runtimes.identity: Asyncio debugger uses task:0x{id(task):x}. create/sample/exit join by that actual Task-derived key. sample captures sampler native TID; thread_current is updated while iterating sampled Tasks, not a proven running-Task CPU binding. Separate USDT converter labels coroutine_id=thread:TID and same-thread edges; it does not emit asyncio Task identity.
limits: Task factory path is instrumented; this source review does not certify transparent runtime-wide lifecycle coverage or all Python versions. Other repository routes were not audited here.
Task.get_stack() samples suspended/live Task stacks, not per-Task on-CPU samples. thread_current in this adapter must not be equated to true task-step scheduler binding.
Task key uses object address without a generation suffix in this inspected adapter; completion cleanup is not heap lifetime/strong-reference or Task-address-reuse proof.
USDT stacks are keyed by OS thread and function names; function probes alone do not establish coroutine creation, current Task, shared-resource owner or queue/IO cause.
README historical service metrics are documentation only; no numeric result is imported into this audit.

source_anchors.fact: Documents Task identity/lifecycle adapter and separately describes external probe routes; not native evidence.
install wraps existing/default Task factory, calls create and installs done callback.
sample uses Task.get_stack and updates thread_current; edges join the Task create base.
done callback distinguishes cancel/exception/exit, emits final segment and clears active/base/thread mappings.
task_id formats Python id(task) as task:0x... without a generation suffix.
Converter labels emitted stack segments coroutine_id=thread:TID and connects same_thread_next_python_stack, not Task identities.

runtimes.route_zh: Task factory／get_stack 插桩适配器；另有线程级 USDT 转换器
runtimes.identity_zh: Task 路径使用 id(task)，没有显式代次；USDT 路径只有 thread:TID。
runtimes.limits_zh: 遍历 Task 时更新的 thread_current 不是实际 on-CPU Task 绑定；get_stack 快照不能当 CPU 样本。

runtimes.route_kind: Runtime-event offline JFR-to-graph adapter, service-oriented; source implementation observed, native compatibility not validated in this pass.
runtimes.identity: thread_metadata chooses eventThread then sampledThread then thread; javaThreadId becomes java-thread:<id>, fallback id/osThreadId becomes jfr-thread:<id>, final fallback thread name. Graph create/sample/exit and successive-event edges share this key, not a managed object address.
limits: Inspected parser consumes an existing JFR file using jfr print; the recording launcher, JVM/JVMTI/SA implementations were not audited. README production recommendations are not executed support proof.

Selected EVENTS list has no mount/unmount or carrier binding event handling; inspected adapter does not reconstruct virtual-thread-to-OS-carrier migration. This is a limit of this file, not universal repository absence.
Thread-name fallback may conflate unnamed/same-name threads; Java logical ID and osThreadId fallback have different identity semantics. Parser output keys do not include process/recording generation.
Park/pinned events classified sample are diagnostic events, not necessarily on-CPU samples; elapsed event duration cannot be treated as CPU or pure runnable delay.
Request/Future/executor/resource ownership requires a case-specific join absent from this inspected parser; no generic callback/task caller benefit verified.

source_anchors.fact: README labels the route JVM/runtime-based and separately describes executor/task-pool adapters.
Adapter enumerates exact runtime JFR event types including VT start/end and diagnostic samples.
Identity preference is logical javaThreadId, then JFR/OS fallback, then name; no object address.
Actual event-to-create/sample/sleep/exception/exit conversion.
Creates base-to-observation edges and same-routine successive event edges keyed by thread metadata.

runtimes.route_zh: 现有 JFR 记录的离线事件解析器
runtimes.identity_zh: 优先 Java 逻辑线程 ID，再退回 JFR／OS ID 或线程名；没有录制代次。

runtimes.route_kind: JVM javaagent ASM instrumentation of specific kotlinx.coroutines AbstractCoroutine and generated invokeSuspend ABI; actual library object lifecycle adapter, beyond the README stdlib semantic demo, limited by matched ABI.
events: invokeSuspend ARETURN or catch-all Throwable -> leave
exceptional completion -> diagnostic sample with Throwable stack/cause chain
runtimes.identity: WeakReference identity-key map assigns monotonically increasing raw IDs to actual AbstractCoroutine Job receivers. Continuation.getContext().get(Job.Key) resolves active Job identity; ThreadLocal stack records currently executing Job. parent_raw_id comes from active invokeSuspend Job at construction; structured_parent_raw_id independently comes from constructor CoroutineContext Job.Key. thread_id is Java Thread.getId, not OS TID.
limits: Transformer matches exact AbstractCoroutine class/method signature plus direct generated state-machine base classes; arbitrary compiler/runtime ABI/version coverage is not established.
Weak keys do not retain Job objects, but complete terminal=false is completion evidence, not coroutine frame/object storage retirement or a destroy/exit event.
No DebugProbes integration in inspected adapter; completion error stacks are diagnostic, not periodic CPU samples. No enqueue/waker/dispatcher admission clock is emitted here.
Continuation class is recorded, but no unique continuation/frame ID is emitted; Job ID cannot be assumed identical to every nested continuation/frame.
Creator active Job and structured parent are distinct relationships; unknown entries/errors are counted. Per-case resource ownership, Future/executor/OS joins need explicit evidence.
README semantic-L1 microbenchmark statements describe a different route; source presence of this agent does not revalidate historical claims or prove compatibility/native benefit.

source_anchors.fact: README explicitly limits its stdlib microbenchmark to semantic L1; this is not a whole-repository absence assertion.
Transformer targets AbstractCoroutine lifecycle and selected state machine bases.
Exact completion-hook signature and invokeSuspend entry/leave instrumentation.
Weak object-identity keys compare referents by reference equality, not identityHashCode uniqueness.
Actual Job receiver allocated a tool ID; creator and structured-parent relationships recorded separately.
Continuation execution maps through actual context Job to tracked Job ID.
Completion emitted terminal=false, so no object-storage retirement inferred.

runtimes.identity_zh: 弱引用对象身份分配 Job ID；活跃 creator 与结构化 parent 分开记录。

runtimes.route_kind: Offline TraceEvent EventPipe/TPL/runtime/SampleProfiler plus optional CoroStitch-TaskBridge parser; service-shaped adapter with exact bridge wire checks. The separate JIT/hardware route is README-only in this limited audit.
events: SampleProfiler stacks require active thread binding -> sample
runtimes.identity: Standard TPL payload TaskID/ContinuationId alternatives are numeric keys rendered task:<id>; per-thread Stack<long> binds active continuation/task for sample attribution. Bridge records instead require logicalIdentity or identityToken >2^32 and exact schemas; diagnosticTaskId remains metadata. This parser does not itself prove bridge-token-to-Task/state-machine object mapping. Unbound worker events use negative native ThreadID fallback.
limits: Standard task/continuation IDs, bridge tokens, async state-machine boxes, work items and OS ThreadID are distinct domains; do not promote all task:<id> output into globally unique object lifetimes. Current parser keys are not visibly process-namespaced.
Bridge handler validates exact event version and fields and rejects legacy TaskId-only records; bridge producer/object mapping and downstream join were not inspected.

off_cpu_wait_interval is this adapter label for AwaitTaskContinuationScheduled to ContinuationStarted relative time. Without OS/GC/dependency/ready evidence, this is not independently measured off-CPU or pure runnable/queue time.

Sample attribution requires a nonempty reconstructed threadActive stack; unmatched samples are retained as counters/examples or omitted from graph. Provider omissions/variants can affect lifecycle/bindings; conservation counters are diagnostics, not proof every logical async frame is covered.
SelectContinuationBoundary uses stack-name predicates; it is a selector rather than an object identity bridge. No per-case queue/resource/Future ownership inference follows automatically.
Optional UTC/monotonic sync maps event timestamps; absent sync gives timestamp_ns=0 while relative milliseconds remain. Clock alignment and process generation require validation.
README JIT execute-breakpoint/eBPF/ARM64 and previous benchmarks were not executed or independently audited here; no universal absence or architecture compatibility claim.

source_anchors.fact: README distinguishes EventPipe diagnostics and a separate targeted JIT/hardware route.
Concrete adapter consumes saved EventPipe data into TraceLog.
Runtime/TPL/sample providers and optional exact bridge are separate branches.

Stack-name selector identifies candidates, not Task/state-machine object uniqueness.
